card.name: Point where a bullet list begins
card.fires_on: Colons or spaces at the end of a lead-in line, right where a bulleted list of items is about to begin. Also a few stray spots in web text where a bullet or list break would follow.

modes.label: Colon before a list
modes.description: A colon ending a sentence that introduces a list of policies or steps.
modes.example: Students should read the USQ policies<<:>> Definitions, Assessment and Student Academic Misconduct

modes.label: Gap before next list item
modes.description: A space or line break between list-like entries on a web page.

card.writes: It promotes bullet symbols such as • and ・, suggesting a list marker comes next.
card.plain: It fires where a sentence ends and a bulleted list is about to start.
